Positive/negative values indicate changes in the measured HH radar return only. They do not by themselves identify flooding, crop damage, crop health, soil moisture or river depth.

The 8 October product is SHSH single-polarization and the 20 October product is DHDH dual-polarization. The shared Frequency-A HHHH channel is used, but product QA and acquisition comparability must be reviewed before drawing environmental conclusions.
